english: This notice announces the course registration schedule for the 2026 Winter Session (동계 계절수업). Students who wish to take courses in the Winter Session should read the attached files carefully and register according to the schedule.
Attachment 1-1. Guide to Course Registration for the 2026 Winter Session
Attachment 1-2. SNU Course Registration System (수강신청 시스템) User Manual (Korean and English)
Attachment 1-3. Card News on Changes to the Course Registration System to Prevent Course Trading (강의매매, selling or buying course seats)
Attachment 2. Notice on Misconduct in Course Registration
Attachment 3. Guide to Duplicate Course Registration (중복수강신청)
